notes: Official-source RAG seed for AE_TOURIST_VISA, exclusively the ICP self-sponsored five-year multiple-entry tourist visa, service 377-005-001-031 and Smart Services transaction 783.

documents.title: UAE ICP Five-Year Multiple-Entry Tourist Visa

chunks.title: AE_TOURIST_VISA is ICP transaction 783 only
chunks.content: AE_TOURIST_VISA is the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security self-sponsored five-year multiple-entry tourist visa only: service code 377-005-001-031, ICP Smart Services transaction 783. Tourism is locked by the product. Sponsor-issued 30-day, 60-day, or 90-day tourist visas, GDRFA products, family or business visits, transit, job exploration, residence, work, study, and other entry permits are separate products and must never be selected inside this form. Official sources: https://icp.gov.ae/en/services-details/?serviceid=68f5bc968c587a0011cb16cd ; https://smartservices.icp.gov.ae/echannels/web/client/guest/index.html#/issueVisa/request/783

chunks.title: Five-year multiple-entry validity and stay limits
chunks.content: The ICP service issues a long-term multiple-entry tourist visa valid for five years. A holder may stay continuously for no more than 90 days, subject to an extension for an equivalent period, while total stay must not exceed the official annual limit. The year is calculated from the first UAE entry, and unused days are not carried into the following year. The first entry must occur within the entry permit's stated validity after issuance. The issued visa and current ICP terms control. Official source: https://icp.gov.ae/en/services-details/?serviceid=68f5bc968c587a0011cb16cd

chunks.title: Passport, funds, insurance, ticket, and accommodation requirements
chunks.content: ICP requires a passport valid for at least six months. The five-year tourist visa also requires proof of a bank balance of USD 4,000 or its equivalent during the six months before application, UAE-valid health-insurance evidence meeting the current service conditions, a return or onward travel ticket, and accommodation evidence. These items must be rechecked against transaction 783 at submission because integrated retrieval and service configuration can change. Official sources: https://icp.gov.ae/en/services-details/?serviceid=68f5bc968c587a0011cb16cd ; https://icp.gov.ae/en/faq/

chunks.title: The selected ICP product is self-sponsored
chunks.content: ICP describes the five-year multiple-entry tourist visa as available without a sponsor. Do not ask the applicant to select an airline, hotel, travel agency, UAE resident, or company as application sponsor, and do not reuse fields from sponsor-issued short-stay products. UAE accommodation and a UAE mobile number, if available, are beneficiary contact facts rather than sponsorship. Official source: https://icp.gov.ae/en/dubai-travel-exhibition/

chunks.title: ICP transaction 783 channel and reconstruction limit
chunks.content: The canonical application channel is ICP Smart Services transaction 783: https://smartservices.icp.gov.ae/echannels/web/client/guest/index.html#/issueVisa/request/783. Public ICP service information and current client templates establish the semantic inventory, but authenticated UAE Pass/login QA is still required to verify exact page order, requiredness, lookup labels and codes, conditionals, integrated data retrieval, and transfer behavior. Treat the schema as an official-source reconstruction and state uncertainty instead of inventing a portal value.

chunks.title: Beneficiary identity and passport answers
chunks.content: Collect full name while preserving synchronized English and official Arabic values internally; current nationality; previous nationality if transaction 783 displays it; profession; gender; date, country, and city or place of birth; religion; marital status; and education level. Passport answers include number, type, issuing country, place and date of issue, and expiry date. Tourism is a locked product value and is not an applicant-facing visa-type or purpose selector. Exact profession, gender, religion, marital-status, education, and passport-type lookup labels and codes remain authenticated-portal-QA pending. Official sources: https://smartservices.icp.gov.ae/echannels/web/client/guest/index.html#/issueVisa/request/783 ; https://icp.gov.ae/en/services-details/?serviceid=68f5bc968c587a0011cb16cd

chunks.title: Contact outside the UAE and accommodation answers
chunks.content: Collect beneficiary email, country of residence, residential address outside the UAE, and telephone number outside the UAE. UAE accommodation details include emirate, dependent city and area, detailed address, building or property name and P.O. box when displayed, whether the beneficiary has a UAE mobile number, and that number when available. Transaction reason may be an authenticated lookup, while visit reason is locked to Tourism. Exact location codes, phone formats, optional-field visibility, and transaction-reason values require live-login QA. Official source: https://smartservices.icp.gov.ae/echannels/web/client/guest/index.html#/issueVisa/request/783

chunks.title: Required evidence belongs to application_documents
chunks.content: Passport biodata page, personal photograph, six-month bank statement showing the required balance, UAE health-coverage evidence, return or onward ticket, and UAE accommodation evidence are application_documents slots, not file-path answers. A national identity copy is conditional for nationalities required by the current ICP transaction configuration. Recheck transaction 783 because ICP can retrieve evidence through integrations or request attachments when retrieval fails. Official sources: https://icp.gov.ae/en/services-details/?serviceid=68f5bc968c587a0011cb16cd ; https://smartservices.icp.gov.ae/echannels/web/client/guest/index.html#/issueVisa/request/783

chunks.title: UAE Pass and transaction operations are not answer fields
chunks.content: UAE Pass or ICP login, authentication, session state, attachment transfer, health-insurance purchase or retrieval, financial-guarantee handling, service fees, and payment are VIZA workflow responsibilities. They must not appear in visa_form_fields or be requested as ordinary applicant answers. The answer schema contains reusable beneficiary facts; upload and transaction state remain outside it. Official sources: https://icp.gov.ae/en/services-details/?serviceid=68f5bc968c587a0011cb16cd ; https://smartservices.icp.gov.ae/echannels/web/client/guest/index.html#/issueVisa/request/783

chunks.title: Passport and identity answers must follow the requested field
chunks.content: Copy full name, passport number, nationality, birth facts, passport type, issuing country, place of issue, issue date, and expiry date from the matching passport field. Do not substitute issuing authority, pickup location, residence, or destination when ICP asks for place or country of issue. Preserve synchronized English and official Arabic values internally where the ICP transaction exposes both, while showing only the selected interface language during entry. Use authenticated portal lookup labels and codes rather than guessed synonyms. Official source: https://smartservices.icp.gov.ae/echannels/web/client/guest/index.html#/issueVisa/request/783
